name: CentralStrategyOntology
description: Formal ontology for Central Garden & Pet corporate strategy, M&A capital allocation, and investment hurdle verification.

concepts.label: Strategic Entity
concepts.description: Root entity for Central Garden & Pet strategic planning and capital allocation.

concepts.label: Strategic Decision
concepts.description: A capital allocation or portfolio restructuring decision at Central Garden & Pet.

concepts.label: Platform Acquisition
concepts.description: A category-defining M&A transaction ($150M–$400M EV) establishing leadership in an accretive consumable sub-vertical.

concepts.label: Bolt-On Acquisition
concepts.description: A targeted tuck-in acquisition ($20M–$75M EV) integrated into an existing business unit.

concepts.label: Divestiture / JV Carve-Out
concepts.description: An access-over-ownership restructuring carve-out moving low-margin physical distribution assets into minority-owned JVs.

concepts.label: Internal Extrusion CapEx
concepts.description: Capital expenditure into proprietary injection molding, soft-chew extrusion, and packaging automation.

concepts.label: Strategic Verdict
concepts.description: The formalized corporate development recommendation on a strategic move.

concepts.label: Approved Strategic Move
concepts.description: A transaction or capital allocation that fully satisfies Central's 4-point hurdle criteria and margin expansion mandate.

concepts.label: Conditional Strategic Move
concepts.description: A transaction requiring valuation re-negotiation, antitrust remedy, or manufacturing synergy verification before sign-off.

concepts.label: Rejected Strategic Move
concepts.description: A proposal that fails margin accretion hurdle, carries excessive commodity food risk, or lacks retail channel moats.

concepts.label: Operating Platform
concepts.description: Central Garden & Pet operating division.

concepts.label: Pet Operating Platform
concepts.description: Central Pet segment (~40% gross margin, ~19% EBITDA), spanning chews, toys, functional wellness, avian, and aquatics.

concepts.label: Garden Operating Platform
concepts.description: Central Garden segment spanning turf grass seed, wild bird, live goods, and lawn controls.

concepts.label: Pet Consumables
concepts.description: Recurring-purchase companion animal consumables delivering high replenish velocity and gross margins above 45%.

concepts.label: Pet Functional Wellness & Supplements
concepts.description: Clinically backed canine and feline nutritional supplements: joint mobility, gut microbiome, calming, and dermatology soft chews.

concepts.label: Pet Natural Chews & Treats
concepts.description: Single-ingredient and natural rawhide-alternative canine chews (Cadet, TDBBS, Nylabone edible chews).

concepts.label: Avian and Small Animal Nutrition
concepts.description: Wild bird feed, caged bird seed, and small animal nutrition (Kaytee brand platform).

concepts.label: Pet Hard Goods & Durables
concepts.description: Durable hardware: glass aquariums, filtration, habitats, nylon chew toys, and cages (Aqueon, Nylabone non-edible).

concepts.label: Commodity Extruded Pet Food
concepts.description: Standard wet/canned and dry extruded kibble pet food. Characterized by capital-intensive plants, high co-packer reliance, and sub-30% gross margins.

concepts.label: Lawn and Turf Seed
concepts.description: High-yield turfgrass seed, forage seed, and lawn establishment products (Pennington Seed brand platform).

concepts.label: Organic Soil and Biological Lawn Care
concepts.description: Microbiome soil conditioners, bio-stimulants, and subscription DTC organic lawn care (Sunday, Espoma Organic archetype).

concepts.label: Live Goods and Nursery
concepts.description: Live greenhouse bedding plants, potted annuals, and perennials (Bell Nursery, Hopewell Nursery).

concepts.label: Synthetic Chemical Fertilizer
concepts.description: Traditional synthetic chemical nitrogen/phosphorus fertilizers subject to input commodity swings.

concepts.label: Central Investment Hurdle Criterion
concepts.description: Non-negotiable acquisition criteria established under CEO Niko Lahanas.

concepts.label: Niche Category Leadership
concepts.description: Target must hold #1 or #2 market position in a defined, defensible sub-vertical.

concepts.label: Consumable / Repeat Velocity
concepts.description: Products must drive recurring replenishment (e.g. monthly Chewy autoship) rather than one-time durable replacement cycles.

concepts.label: Omnichannel & Retail Moats
concepts.description: Target must immediately plug into Central's tier-1 retail footprint: Walmart, Target, Home Depot, Lowe's, Chewy, Amazon.

concepts.label: Margin Accretion Hurdle
concepts.description: Target must deliver Gross Margin > 40% and EBITDA > 19% to reinforce corporate margin expansion mandate.

concepts.label: Strategic Target Archetype
concepts.description: Archetypes evaluated for Central Garden & Pet portfolio expansion.

concepts.label: Clinically Backed Pet Wellness Target
concepts.description: Exemplified by Zesty Paws / Nutramax: 55%+ Gross Margin, non-seasonal, high repeat Chewy autoship, insources into Nylabone extrusion.

concepts.label: Organic Soil & Biological Lawn Target
concepts.description: Exemplified by Sunday / Espoma Organic: 42–46% Gross Margin, bio-stimulants, DTC soil testing, seasonal spring demand.

concepts.label: Commodity Extruded Food Target
concepts.description: High-volume private label wet/dry food: sub-30% Gross Margin, capital intensive, dilutive to Central's margin mandate.

concepts.label: M&A Synergy Vector
concepts.description: Core operational and commercial synergy vectors unlocked post-acquisition.

concepts.label: Extrusion Manufacturing Insourcing
concepts.description: Absorb external soft-chew contract manufacturing volume into Central's proprietary Nylabone extrusion facilities.

concepts.label: Tier-1 Mass Retail Door Scale
concepts.description: Plug acquired brand into Central's existing vendor grid across 28,000+ Walmart, Target, Petco, and Home Depot doors.

concepts.label: Digital & Autoship Compounding
concepts.description: Capture 70%+ monthly repeat replenishment orders across Chewy Autoship and Amazon Subscribe & Save.

concepts.label: JV Logistics & Distribution Efficiency
concepts.description: Route acquired freight through Central's minority-owned JV distribution networks ('access over ownership').
